text: Historic395 targeted Linux menu[disabled=true] and panel-disabled-color. Current selector is menu[disabled] with --text-color-disabled. Keep disabled presence semantics and current token consumers. This complements shared context-menu295 disabled/hover/checked coverage but does not prove visual contrast on Linux.
title: Use current disabled state selectors and theme tokens
